script: Good morning, store managers. The energy-monitoring portal will be offline tonight from nine until midnight while technicians recalibrate the rooftop solar meters. This work will not interrupt electricity in any store. However, automated energy reports scheduled during that period will be generated tomorrow morning instead. Managers do not need to submit manual readings unless an alert remains visible after the portal returns. A short guide to the updated dashboard will be posted in the operations library on Friday.

If the updated guide is unavailable
questions.exp: 公告明確限定 unless an alert remains visible after the portal returns；只有平台恢復後警示仍存在，才需提交人工讀數。

They must use the west entrance

script: Hello, this is Karen from Apex Office Supplies. I'm calling about order 5842. The blue folders are temporarily out of stock, so we can send green ones today or ship the blue folders next Monday. Please call me before 4 P.M. to let me know which option you prefer.

questions.exp: 來電討論訂單 5842。

questions.text: What item is unavailable?
questions.exp: 藍色資料夾缺貨。

questions.text: What does the speaker request?
questions.exp: 要求四點前回覆選項。

script: Good morning, shoppers. Beginning today, the home appliance department has moved from the third floor to the newly renovated second floor. To celebrate, all small kitchen appliances are fifteen percent off through Sunday. Please ask a sales associate for assistance.

questions.text: What has changed?

questions.text: What is discounted?

questions.text: Until when is the discount offered?
questions.exp: 公告明確說 through Sunday。

script: Thank you for calling Martin's Furniture. Our showroom is open Monday through Saturday from nine to six. For information about an existing delivery, press one. To schedule a design consultation, press two. To speak with a billing representative, remain on the line.

questions.text: When is the showroom closed?
questions.exp: 營業日為週一至週六，因此週日休息。

questions.text: What should callers do to arrange a design consultation?
